indexRule: Use source RNG byte low three bits for horizontal direction and source clock byte low three bits for vertical direction. Index 0..3 yields negative velocity -96 + 16*index; 4..7 yields positive velocity 48 + 16*(index-4). A positive X sets kind bit 1, negative X clears it.
limits: The eight source direction values match hash-checked private RAM in both user snapshots; only the four listed choices have been observed at the executing slot-12 routine in these bounded replays. The Z80 refresh-register RNG input, system-clock phase, enemy update cadence and autonomous game behavior remain unported. No original table bytes, instructions or private replay frames are committed.
